fato_historico: 1970: An aircraft carrying the Wichita State University football team, administrators, and supporters crashes in Colorado, killing 31 people.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may reflect on the delicate beauty of existence today. Just as a garden recovers after a storm, consider how you can transform heavy memories into seeds of strength. It is a good time to cherish your connections deeply, embracing the light of every moment while honoring the resilience within your own powerful heart.
frase_do_dia: Every sunset holds the promise of a brighter, more hopeful dawn for your soul.
significado_numero: Represents the profound power of collective memory and healing energy.
conselho: Nurture your closest bonds and hold your loved ones a little closer today.
